web-apps.name: Web Apps
web-apps.description: Dynamic, interactive, and scalable web applications built to grow with your business — from internal tools to customer-facing platforms.
web-apps.lead: Software that runs in the browser and fits the way your business already works.
intro: We build web applications around your process instead of asking you to adapt to an off-the-shelf product.
Each one is planned to grow: users, screens and features can be added later without starting again.
includes: Planning the screens and the flow together with you
Hebrew, Arabic and English interfaces, including right-to-left layouts
fit: Your work is spread across spreadsheets and messages
A ready-made product covers only part of what you need
Staff or customers need access from any device

websites.name: Custom Website Design
websites.short: Business sites, online stores and blogs.
websites.description: Business websites, e-commerce stores, and blogs — built from scratch, fast-loading, and designed around your brand instead of a template.
websites.lead: A site designed around your brand, written in code and not assembled from a template.
intro: We design and build the site ourselves, so the layout, the content and the speed stay under your control.
The result is light pages that are built for phones first and are ready for search engines.
includes: An online store or catalogue when you need one
Search basics: titles, descriptions, sitemap and structured data
fit: You are opening a business or replacing an old site
You sell online or plan to
Your customers read more than one language

systems.name: Systems Development
systems.description: Process automation, third-party integrations, and backend systems that remove manual work and connect the tools your business already uses.
systems.lead: Less manual work, and tools that pass information to each other on their own.
intro: We connect the software your business already uses and automate the steps people repeat every day.
Where no existing tool does the job, we build the backend service that does.
includes: Mapping the current process and where it gets stuck
Automated documents, messages and data sync
fit: The same data is typed into more than one place
A routine task takes hours every week
Your tools do not talk to each other

ecommerce-platform.title: E-commerce Platform
ecommerce-platform.description: A custom e-commerce platform with independent storefronts, multilingual support, and a shopping experience tailored to each brand.
ecommerce-platform.lead: A store platform where every brand gets its own storefront.
overview: The platform lets several storefronts run independently, each with its own look and content.
Shoppers browse in their own language, and the buying flow is adjusted to the brand and not fixed by a template.

collections-system.title: Customer Follow-Up & Debt Collection System
collections-system.description: A system for customer follow-up and collections, with tailored workflows and business-data synchronization.
collections-system.lead: One place to follow up with customers and track what is owed.
overview: The team sees a clear picture of each customer: what was agreed, what is outstanding and what the next step is.
Workflows follow the way the business already handles collections, and data is kept in sync so nobody works from an old list.
features: Collection workflows shaped to the business

custom-crm.title: Custom CRM System
custom-crm.description: A custom management system that brings business information and workflows together in one place.
custom-crm.lead: A management system shaped around one business, not a generic product.
overview: Information that used to live in different places is gathered into a single system.
Screens and workflows were designed for how this business works day to day.

digital-menu.title: Digital Menu
digital-menu.description: A mobile-friendly digital interface with organised content and an easy-to-use experience.
digital-menu.lead: A menu customers open on their own phone.
overview: Content is arranged in clear sections so customers find what they want quickly.
The interface is built for small screens first and is available in more than one language.
features: Content that is easy to scan

document-automation.title: Document Automation Service
document-automation.description: An automation service for processing documents and delivering results efficiently.
document-automation.lead: A small service that takes documents in and returns results without manual handling.
overview: The service processes documents automatically and delivers the output where it is needed.
It runs as a standalone microservice, so other systems can use it without being changed.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Web Reflect wants everyone to be able to use this website, including people with disabilities. Last updated: October 5, 2026.

sections.heading: What we did
paragraphs: The site is built to follow the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at level AA: text contrast, visible keyboard focus, a correct heading order, text alternatives for images and full keyboard operation.
An accessibility menu is available on every page. It lets you enlarge the text, switch to high contrast, underline links and stop animations. Your choices are saved in your browser only.

sections.heading: Known limitations
paragraphs: Client logos are shown as supplied by the clients and may contain small text. Third-party services we link to, such as WhatsApp, are outside our control.

sections.heading: Found a problem?
paragraphs: If something on the site is hard to use, write to {email} and tell us which page and what happened. We will look into it and reply.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information Web Reflect collects, why we use it, and the choices available to you. Last updated: September 12, 2026.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When you contact us by email, telephone, or WhatsApp, we may receive information you choose to provide, such as your name, contact details, company details, and the contents of your enquiry.

Hosting and technical providers may process limited technical data needed to operate and secure the website, including IP address, browser and device information, requested pages, and request time. We do not use advertising pixels, analytics trackers, or account registration.

When you choose an accessibility setting, such as text size, high contrast, or underlined links, we store that preference only in your browser's local storage so it can be remembered on later visits. This preference is not used for advertising or visitor tracking.

sections.heading: How we use and share information
paragraphs: We use information to respond to enquiries, provide requested services, manage business communications, protect the website, and meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal information or use it for unrelated advertising.

We share information only where necessary to provide services, operate and secure the site, comply with law, or protect our rights. WhatsApp communications are also subject to WhatsApp's privacy practices.

sections.heading: Retention, security, and deletion
paragraphs: We retain information only as long as reasonably needed or legally required and use reasonable safeguards to protect it. No internet transmission or storage system is completely secure.

You may request access, correction, or deletion by emailing {email} with the subject Data deletion request. Include enough information to identify your request. We will respond under applicable law; some data may need to be retained where permitted or required.

sections.heading: Changes and contact
paragraphs: We may update this policy when our practices or legal requirements change. The latest version will be posted here. Privacy questions: {email}.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of the Web Reflect website. Last updated: September 12, 2026.

sections.heading: Using this website
paragraphs: Use this website only for lawful personal or business purposes. Do not interfere with its operation, attempt unauthorized access, introduce harmful code, or use its content in a way that infringes the rights of Web Reflect or others.

sections.heading: Website content and enquiries
paragraphs: Unless stated otherwise, this website's design, text, graphics, logos, and other content are owned by or licensed to Web Reflect. You may not copy, modify, distribute, or use them commercially without written permission.
Information on this site is general information and does not create a contractual relationship. Services, scope, timing, fees, and deliverables must be agreed in a separate written agreement.

sections.heading: External links, disclaimer, and changes
paragraphs: Third-party services, including WhatsApp, are independent of Web Reflect. We are not responsible for their content, availability, or privacy practices.
The website is provided as is and as available to the extent permitted by law. We may change these terms or the website at any time. Questions: {email}.
